opening: It started the night after my last filgrastim dose.
Today is the fourth day of the fever.
After my operation I had chemotherapy with paclitaxel and carboplatin, and I've completed all six cycles.
After my fifth and sixth cycles my blood counts dropped (myelosuppression).

opening.text: I've had a high fever for four days now, starting the night after my last filgrastim dose. I've had ovarian cancer in the past and had chemo with paclitaxel and carboplatin after my operation, finishing all six cycles. My blood counts dropped after my fifth and sixth cycles.
